questions.prompt: How does the programme plan to widen young people’s access to theatre?
options: By funding buildings before planning activities.
By focusing on training for existing theatre staff.
By combining affordable visits with creative participation.
By replacing live performances with school recordings.
questions.explanationZh: 计划同时提供低价观演、学校演出和创作培训，不只是建设场馆或培训现有员工。

questions.prompt: Why is a Skills Roadshow included in the plans?
options: To offer opportunities in places without theatres.
To select which theatres receive touring productions.
To train teachers to sell tickets in their schools.
To move community shows to the National Theatre.
questions.explanationZh: s10明确巡展面向没有剧院的地方，直接把机会带给当地年轻人。

questions.prompt: What role is planned for the Nationwide Youth Council?
options: Approving the final funding for the partnership.
Setting ticket prices for regional performances.
Choosing the twelve existing regional partners.
Helping shape the activities offered to young people.
questions.explanationZh: s11说明青年委员会帮助设计活动，没有授予拨款审批或票价制定职责。

questions.prompt: What can readers conclude about the announced funding?
options: The whole amount has already reached the partners.
Its award depends on the formal review process.
It will be paid directly to individual ticket buyers.
The Youth Council will decide whether it is granted.
questions.explanationZh: s12–14明确拨款和实施须经正式程序，不能把至多金额理解为已经拨付。
